answer: The shrimp-paste shed holds baskets of tiny shrimp, the pounding mortars lined up on the bench. Proof of shrimp-paste maker via belacan block tally — a block the paste-maker pounds only after 33 blocks hold their set without one crumbling at the edge, each pounded by the paste-maker herself. haven pounds the shrimp with salt till the paste turns pink. ferrous packs the paste into blocks and wraps them in banana leaf. pearl sets the blocks in the sun to cure. Thirty-three blocks must hold their set without one crumbling at the edge, and the next still crumbles where the salt ran thin.
